sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The "Release events" column gave up on the first refusal, and said nothing. It is filled by a single request for the whole page, so one "503 Service Unavailable" from MusicBrainz left the entire column empty — with no message, no marker, and no way to ask again short of reloading the page. The request is now retried up to three times like every other Web Service call the script makes (503, 502, 504 and 429, honouring a "Retry-After" header), so most refusals pass unnoticed. A 404 is still taken at face value.

A failed lookup no longer counts as an answer. The cells are left genuinely empty rather than marked as finished, so a later attempt fills every one of them instead of skipping over cells it thinks it has already done.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The "Release events" column header now says what happened, and lets you retry. While the lookup is in flight it shows ⏳; if it finally fails it shows a yellow ⚠ instead — hover for the reason ("HTTP 503"), click to ask again. A successful retry fills the column and the ⚠ disappears. It survives filtering and sorting, so you cannot lose the retry by typing, and nothing at all is added to the header when the lookup works. This is the first retry the script offers at the level of a single column.
